label: OBi302 2-port FXS ATA
description: Small-office analog telephone adapter with 2 RJ-11 FXS ports registering up to 4 SIP/OBiTALK services, connected through two 10/100BASE-T Ethernet ports (Internet plus a LAN passthrough).
notes: Included as the verified stand-in for the Yealink SIP-T31P in the request: the T31P is a 2-line entry-level desk IP phone (132x64 LCD, PoE, 2 VoIP accounts), not a gateway or ATA, so it cannot be specced in this batch. Poly OBi302 spec sheet: Internet (WAN) 2 x 10/100BaseT Ethernet, Phone 2 x RJ-11 FXS, plus a USB 2.0 port that is not modelled. No gigabit, no PoE (USB power or adapter). FXS ports are analog and not modelled.
